original: v1 oṃ devarṣisiddhagaṇakinnaranāgayakṣavidyādharādhyuṣitasānur anantaratnaḥ / puṇyas tripiṣṭapataloddhṛtadevaramyaḥ _ _ ^ _ ^ ^ ^ _ ^ ^ _
analyzed: om deva ṛṣi siddha gaṇa kinnara nāga yakṣa vidyādhara adhyuṣita sānuḥ ananta ratnaḥ puṇyaḥ tripiṣṭapa tala uddhṛta deva ramyaḥ

original: 2 n udagraḥ // 1 // yatra sphuṭanmaṇisahasramayūkhajālavikṣobhitaṃ daśasu dikṣu bhayāt pralinam* / candroḍusūryahutabhuṅnilayābhiśaṃki prāvṛḍniśāsv
analyzed: n udagraḥ yatra sphuṭat maṇi sahasra mayūkha jāla vikṣobhitam daśasu dikṣu bhayāt pralinam candra uḍu sūrya hutabhuj nilaya abhiśaṃki prāvṛṣ niśāsu

original: 3 api punar na tamo 'bhyupaiti // 2 // yaḥ sevyate munigaṇair aniśaṃ saśiṣyair naikaiḥ samitkuśaphalodakapuṣpahastaiḥ / svargāṅganābhir api ca pravimṛṣṭaśākhāḥ
analyzed: api punar na tamaḥ bhyupaiti yaḥ sevyate muni gaṇaiḥ aniśam sa śiṣyaiḥ na ekaiḥ samidh kuśa phala udaka puṣpa hastaiḥ svarga aṅganābhiḥ api ca pravimṛṣṭa śākhāḥ

original: 4 kuṃjeṣu yasya taravaḥ kusumārthinībhiḥ // 3 // yatra trilocanajaṭāmukuṭaikadeśa nityasthitoḍupatidīdhitisaṃprayogāt* / śītau divāpi himavatsphaṭikopalābham ambv
analyzed: kuñjeṣu yasya taravaḥ kusuma arthinībhiḥ 3 yatra trilocana jaṭā mukuṭa eka deśa nitya sthita uḍupati dīdhiti saṃprayogāt śītau divā api himavat sphaṭika upala ābham ambu

original: 5 indukāntamaṇayaḥ pracuraṃ sravanti // 4 // yasyābdamuktajaladhautaśilātaleṣu kuṃjeṣu naikavidhavīgaṇanāditeṣu / ramyeṣu puṣpaphaladadrumasaṃkaṭeṣu
analyzed: indukānta maṇayaḥ pracuram sravanti yasya abda mukta jaladhauta śilā taleṣu kuṃjeṣu na eka vidhavī gaṇa nāditeṣu ramyeṣu puṣpa phalada druma saṃkaṭeṣu

original: 6 rātrau hutāśanavad auṣadhayo jvalanti // 5 // candrāṃśugauratarakeśarabhārabhṛdbhir mattebhamastakataṭakṣatajotkṣitāṃśaiḥ / siṃhaiḥ śiloccayaguhāvadanāṭṭahāsair
analyzed: rātrau hutāśana vat auṣadhayaḥ jvalanti candra aṃśu gauratara kesara bhāra bhṛdbhiḥ matta ibha mastaka taṭa kṣataja utkṣita aṃśaiḥ siṃhaiḥ śiloccaya guhā vadana aṭṭahāsaiḥ

original: 7 na kṣamyate 'mbudharavṛndaravo 'pi yatra // 6 // tasmin girāv avanimaṇḍalamaṇḍabhūte sarvātithāv iva jagad vibhavapradānaiḥ / sarvartupuṣpaphalavaddrumaramyasānāv
analyzed: na kṣamyate mbudhara vṛnda ravaḥ yatra tasmin girau avani maṇḍala maṇḍa bhūte sarva atithau iva jagat vibhava pradānaiḥ sarva ṛtu puṣpa phalavat druma ramya sānau

original: 8 ete vidhūtatamaso munayo vasanti // 7 // ātreyahāritaparāśarabhelagargaśāṃbavyasuśrutavasiṣṭhakarālakāpyaḥ / sarvauṣadhīrasaguṇākṛtivīryanāmajijñāsavaḥ
analyzed: ete vidhūta tamasaḥ munayaḥ vasanti ātreya hārita parāśara bhela garga śāṃbavya suśruta vasiṣṭha karāla kāpyaḥ sarva oṣadhī rasa guṇa ākṛti vīrya nāma jijñāsavaḥ

original: 9 samuditāḥ śataśaḥ praceruḥ // 8 // dṛṣṭvā patrair haritaharitair indranīlaprakāśaiḥ kandaiḥ kundasphaṭikakumudendvaṃśuśaṃkhābhraśubhraiḥ / utpannāstho
analyzed: samuditāḥ śataśas praceruḥ dṛṣṭvā patraiḥ harita haritaiḥ indranīla prakāśaiḥ kandaiḥ kunda sphaṭika kumuda indu aṃśu śaṃkha abhra śubhraiḥ

original: 10 munim upagataḥ suśrutaḥ kāśirājaṃ kinv etat syād atha sa bhagavān āha tasmai yathāvat* // 9 // purāmṛtaṃ pramathitam asurendraḥ svayaṃ papau / tasya ciccheda bhagavān uttamāṃgaṃ
analyzed: munim upagataḥ suśrutaḥ kāśi rājam kinu etat syāt atha sa bhagavān āha tasmai yathāvat purā amṛtam pramathitam asura indraḥ svayam papau tasya ciccheda bhagavān uttamāṃgam

original: 11 janārdanaḥ // 10 // kaṇṭhanāḍī samāsannā vicchinne tasya mūrdhani / vindavaḥ patitā bhūmāv ādyaṃ tasyeha janma tu // 11 //
analyzed: janārdanaḥ kaṇṭha nāḍī samāsannā vicchinne tasya mūrdhani vindavaḥ patitāḥ bhūmau ādyam tasya iha janma tu

original: I. Fol. 2: Bower manuscript
analyzed: R Fol 2 Bower manuscript

original: r1 na bhakṣayanty enam ataś ca viprāḥ śarīrasaṃparkaviniḥsṛtatvāt* / gandhogratām apy ata eva cāsya vadanti śāstrādhigamapravīṇāḥ // 12 // lavaṇarasaviyogād āhur enaṃ raśūnam
analyzed: na bhakṣayanti enam atas ca viprāḥ śarīra samparka viniḥsṛta tvāt gandha ugra tām api atas eva ca asya vadanti śāstra adhigama pravīṇāḥ lavaṇa rasa viyogāt āhuḥ enam raśūnam

original: 2 laśuna iti tu saṃjñā cāsya lokapratītā / bahubhir iha kim uktair deśabhāṣābhidhānaiḥ śṛṇu rasaguṇavīryāṇy asya caivopayogāt* // 13 // rase ca pāke ca kaṭuḥ pradiṣṭaḥ
analyzed: laśunaḥ iti tu saṃjñā ca asya loka pratītā bahubhiḥ iha kim uktaiḥ deśa bhāṣā abhidhānaiḥ śṛṇu rasa guṇa vīryāṇi asya ca eva upayogāt rase ca pāke ca kaṭuḥ pradiṣṭaḥ

original: 3 pāke tathā svādur udāhṛto 'nyaḥ / laghuś ca gandhena sa durjaraś ca vīryeṇa coṣṇaḥ prathitaś ca vṛṣyaḥ // 14 // āṃbloṣṇasnehabhāvāt pavanabalaharaḥ
analyzed: pāke tathā svāduḥ udāhṛtaḥ nyaḥ laghuḥ ca gandhena sa durjaraḥ ca vīryeṇa ca uṣṇaḥ prathitaḥ ca vṛṣyaḥ āṃbla uṣṇa sneha bhāvāt pavana bala haraḥ

original: 4 prokto munivṛṣaiḥ madhuryāt pittabhāvād api ca sa rasatayā pittapraśamanaḥ / auṣṇyāt taikṣṇyāt kaṭutvāt kaphabalavijayī vidvadbhir uditaḥ sarvān rogān nihanyād iti
analyzed: proktaḥ muni vṛṣaiḥ madhuryāt pitta bhāvāt api ca sa rasatayā pitta praśamanaḥ auṣṇyāt taikṣṇyāt kaṭu tvāt kapha bala vijayī vidvadbhiḥ uditaḥ sarvān rogān nihanyāt iti

original: 5 vidhivihito doṣatrayaharaḥ // 15 // pavanaṃ vinihanty api cāsthigataṃ kapham apy acirād uditaṃ śamayet* / janayed api cāgnibalaṃ prabalaṃ balavarṇakaraḥ pravaraś ca
analyzed: vidhi vihitaḥ doṣatraya haraḥ pavanam vinihanti api ca asthi gatam kapham api acirāt uditam śamayet janayet api ca agni balam prabalam bala varṇa karaḥ pravaraḥ ca

original: 6 mataḥ // 16 // atha khalu bahuvidhamadyamāṃsasarpir yavagodhūmabhujāṃ sukhātmakānām* / ayam iha laśunotsavaḥ prayojyo nimakāle ca madhau ca mādhave ca // 17 //
analyzed: mataḥ atha khalu bahuvidha madya māṃsa sarpiḥ yava godhūma bhujām sukha ātmakānām ayam iha laśuna utsavaḥ prayojyaḥ nima kāle ca madhau ca mādhave ca

original: 7 tyajyante kāminībhir jayanasamucitā yatra kañcīkalāpāḥ hārāḥ śaityān na vakṣastanataṭayugalā pīḍanāt saṃprayānti / kāntā nendvaṅśujālavyatikarasubhagā harmyapṛṣṭhopabhogāḥ
analyzed: tyajyante kāminībhiḥ jayana samucitāḥ yatra kañcī kalāpāḥ hārāḥ śaityāt na vakṣaḥ stana taṭa yugalā pīḍanāt saṃprayānti kāntāḥ na indu aṅśu jāla vyatikara subhagāḥ harmya pṛṣṭha upabhogāḥ

original: 8 kāle tasmin prayojyo hy aguru bahumataṃ kuṃkum āṃkāś ca yatra // 18 // harmyāgreṣv atha toraṇeṣu balabhīdvāreṣu cāviṣkṛtāḥ kandāḍhyā laśunasrajo viracayed bhūmau
analyzed: kāle tasmin prayojyaḥ hi aguru bahu matam kuṃkum āṃkāḥ ca yatra harmya agreṣu atha toraṇeṣu balabhī dvāreṣu ca āviṣkṛtāḥ kanda āḍhyāḥ laśuna srajaḥ viracayet bhūmau

original: 9 tathaivārcanam* / mālās tat paricārakasya ca janasyāropayet tan mayīr ity asyaiṣa vidhir janasya vihitaḥ svalpopamā nāmataḥ // 19 // atha śuddhatanuḥ śucir viviktaḥ
analyzed: tathā eva arcanam mālāḥ tat paricārakasya ca janasya āropayet tat mayīḥ iti asya eṣa vidhiḥ janasya vihitaḥ svalpopamā nāmataḥ 19 atha śuddha tanuḥ śuciḥ viviktaḥ

original: 10 suraviprān pratipūjya pāvakaṃ ca / laśunāt svarasaṃ paṭāntapūtaṃ prapibed ahni śubhagraharkṣayukte // 20 // kuḍavaṃ kuḍavād athāpi cārdhaṃ kuḍavaṃ sārdham ato 'pi vātimātram* /
analyzed: sura viprān pratipūjya pāvakam ca laśunāt sva rasam paṭa anta pūtam prapibet ahni śubha graha ṛkṣa yukte kuḍavam kuḍavāt atha api ca ardham kuḍavam sārdham vā atimātram

original: v1 niyatā na hi kācid atra mātrā prapibed doṣabalāmayāni dṛṣṭvā // 21 // satālavṛntavyajanānilaiḥ śubhaiḥ pibantam enaṃ samabhispṛśec chanaiḥ /
analyzed: niyatā na hi kācid atra mātrā prapibet doṣa bala āmayāni dṛṣṭvā sa tālavṛnta vyajana anilaiḥ śubhaiḥ pibantam enam samabhispṛśet śanais

original: 2 bhavet tu mūrcchā pibato 'pi vā yadi spṛśet tataḥ śītajalaiḥ sacandanaiḥ // 22 // surātritīyāṃśavimūrcchitasya gaṇḍūṣam ekaṃ prapibed rasasya / pūrvaṃ galakrīḍividhānahetoḥ
analyzed: bhavet tu mūrcchā vā yadi spṛśet tatas śīta jalaiḥ sa candanaiḥ surā tritīya aṃśa vimūrcchitasya gaṇḍūṣam ekam prapibet rasasya pūrvam galakrīḍi vidhāna hetoḥ

original: 3 sthitvā muhūrtaṃ ca pibet saśeṣam* // 23 // tasmiñ jīrṇe kṣiraśālyānnabhuk syāt kṣirāyojyo jāṃgalānāṃ rasair vā / hṛdyair yūṣaiḥ saṃskṛtair vaidalair vā yuktaḥ snehair mātrayaikaṃ ca
analyzed: sthitvā muhūrtam ca pibet sa śeṣam tasmin jīrṇe kṣira śālyā anna bhuj syāt kṣira āyojyaḥ jāṃgalānām rasaiḥ vā hṛdyaiḥ yūṣaiḥ saṃskṛtaiḥ vaidalaiḥ vā yuktaḥ snehaiḥ mātrayā ekam ca

original: 4 kālam* // 24 // piben mārdvīkaṃ vā madhu madhusaṃāṃśac chātamadirām ariṣṭaṃ śīdhuṃ vā jagalam agajaṃ maireyam api vā / ato 'nyad vā madyaṃ bhavati guṇavad yat tat sasalilaṃ pibed ekaikaṃ vā na
analyzed: kālam pibet mārdvīkam vā madhu śāta madirām ariṣṭam śīdhum vā jagalam agajam maireyam api vā atas vā madyam bhavati guṇavat yat tat sa salilam pibet ekaikam vā na

original: 5 bhavati yathā madyavyatikaraḥ // 25 // amadyapaḥ sukhodakaṃ pibet tathāmblakāṃcikam* / tuṣodakaṃ suvīrajaṃ pibec ca mastu yac chubham* // 26 // na guḍena kathaṃcid enam adyān na tathāmaṃ ca jalaṃ pibet
analyzed: bhavati yathā madya vyatikaraḥ amadyapaḥ sukha udakam pibet tathā ambla kāṃcikam tuṣodakam suvīra jam pibet ca mastu yat śubham na guḍena kathaṃcid enam adyāt na tathā āmam ca jalam pibet

original: 6 prayujan* / satataṃ ca bhaved ajīrṇaśaṃkī na ca khāded abahūni vāsarāṇi // 27 // atha kandāñ cchubhāñ cchlakṣṇān piṣṭān sarpiś ca tatsamam* / khajenābhipramathyaitad ekadhyaṃ ghṛtabhājane // 28 //
analyzed: satatam ca bhavet ajīrṇa śaṃkī na ca khādet abahūni vāsarāṇi atha kandān śubhān ślakṣṇān piṣṭān sarpiḥ ca tad samam khajena abhipramathya etat ekadhyam ghṛta bhājane 28

original: 7 vyuṣṭaṃ daśāhāt prabhṛti bhakṣayed bilvasaṃmitam* / jīrṇe ca rasakalpoktam āhāravidhim ācaret* // 29 // dvāv apy etāv abhihitau kalpau prāgraharau mayā / anayor yatnavān
analyzed: vyuṣṭam daśa ahāt prabhṛti bhakṣayet bilva saṃmitam jīrṇe ca rasakalpa uktam āhāra vidhim ācaret dvau api etau abhihitau kalpau prāgra harau mayā anayoḥ yatnavān

original: 8 nā syāt kalpān anyāñ cchṛṇuṣva me // 30 // kandāñ cchaṅkhābhān apahṛtamalān saktu kulmāsacukraiḥ sarpistailābhyāṃ samita vikṛtaiḥ sūpamāṃsaprakāraiḥ / maudgaiś cūrṇair haritakayutair
analyzed: nā syāt kalpān anyān śṛṇuṣva me kandān śaṅkha ābhān apahṛta malān saktu kulmāsa cukraiḥ sarpiḥ tailābhyām samita vikṛtaiḥ sūpa māṃsa prakāraiḥ maudgaiḥ cūrṇaiḥ haritaka yutaiḥ

original: 9 gandhasauvarcalāḍhyair adyāt saṃskārair bahubhir aparaiḥ sādhitān vetarāṇi // 32 // māṃsaiḥ sārdhaṃ sādhayitvāsya kāṇḍaṃ pūtaṃ hṛdyaṃ taṃ rasaṃ pāyayīta / siddhaṃ tadvat kṣīram asmai
analyzed: gandha sauvarcala āḍhyaiḥ adyāt saṃskāraiḥ bahubhiḥ aparaiḥ sādhitān vā itarāṇi māṃsaiḥ sārdham sādhayitvā asya kāṇḍam pūtam hṛdyam tam rasam pāyayīta siddham tadvat kṣīram asmai

original: 10 pradadyād yūṣaṃ vā syād vaidalaṃ tadvimiśram* // 32 // atha tailaśuktasahitaṃ laśunaṃ nihitaṃ yaveṣu parilipya mṛdā / sthitam ekam abdam upayujya naraḥ sucire sthitān
analyzed: pradadyāt yūṣam vā syāt vaidalam tad vimiśram

original: 11 api jahāti gadān* // 33 // triratnam uṣitā tu gaur anatṛṇā yadā syāt tadā tṛṇārdham upakalpayel laśuna _ ^ _ _ ^ _ /
analyzed: api jahāti gadān triratnam uṣitā tu gauḥ an atṛṇā yadā syāt tadā tṛṇa ardham upakalpayet laśuna

original: I. Fol. 3: Bower manuscript
analyzed: R Fol 3 Bower manuscript

original: r1 payodadhighṛtāni takram athavāpi tad brāhmaṇaḥ prayujya vividhān gadān abhivijitya śarmī bhavet* // 34 // prasthān dvātriṃśal laśunarasataḥ
analyzed: r1 payas dadhi ghṛtāni takram athavā api tat brāhmaṇaḥ prayujya vividhān gadān abhivijitya śarmī bhavet 34 prasthān dvātriṃśat laśuna rasāt

original: 2 kiṇvam ardhārdham asmāt tailaprastho vyapagatamalaḥ piṣṭataḥ ṣaṭ ca deyāḥ / dadyān nikvāthād api ca kalaśaṃ meṣaśṛṃgyāḥ
analyzed: kiṇvam ardha ardham asmāt taila prasthaḥ vyapagata malaḥ piṣṭataḥ ṣaṭ ca deyāḥ dadyāt nikvāthāt api ca kalaśam meṣaśṛṃgyāḥ

original: 3 suśītaṃ prasthau ca dvau punar abhiharet tatra piṣṭasya dhīmān* // 35 // iti sureyaṃ paṃca paṃcāhād rasavarṇagandhaiḥ samanvitā
analyzed: su śītam prasthau ca dvau punar abhiharet tatra piṣṭasya dhīmān iti surā iyam pañca pañca ahāt rasa varṇa gandhaiḥ samanvitā

original: 4 bhavati tailaṃ nāmataś cedam udīrṇam atyarthakārmukam* / tailam etad yaḥ surām api vā puruṣaḥ prayuṃjīta yatnataḥ
analyzed: bhavati tailam nāmataḥ ca idam udīrṇam atyartha kārmukam tailam etat yaḥ surām api vā puruṣaḥ prayuṃjīta yatnataḥ

original: 5 pariharanti taṃ gadānīkāny ājau kṛtāstrān ivetare // 36 // prasthaṃ piṣṭvā śodhitam ekaṃ laśunānāṃ yuṃjyāc cūrṇais traiphalair ardhapalitaiḥ /
analyzed: pariharanti tam gadā anīkāni ājau kṛtāstrān iva itare prastham piṣṭvā śodhitam ekam laśunānām yuṃjyāt cūrṇaiḥ traiphalaiḥ ardha palitaiḥ

original: 6 sarpistailābhyāṃ kuḍavaś ceti daśāhaṃ vyuṣṭaṃ kāsaśvāsaviḍaṃ vighnam uśanti // 37 // hanyād yukto mārutagulmaṃ pavanaghnaiḥ
analyzed: sarpiḥ tailābhyām kuḍavaḥ ca iti daśa aham vyuṣṭam kāsa śvāsa viḍam vighnam uśanti hanyāt yuktaḥ māruta gulmam pavana ghnaiḥ

original: 7 kuṣṭaṃ hanyād yojitamātraṃ khadireṇa / kāsaśvāsaghno hayagandhāvyatimiśraḥ svaryaḥ proktaś caiṣa vimiśro madhuyaṣṭyā // 38 // nānāvidhān eṣa nihanti rogān
analyzed: kuṣṭam hanyāt yojita mātram khadireṇa kāsa śvāsa ghnaḥ hayagandhā vyatimiśraḥ svaryaḥ proktaḥ ca eṣa vimiśraḥ madhuyaṣṭyā nānāvidhān eṣa nihanti rogān

original: 8 nānāvidhadravyaviśeṣayuktaḥ / na yantraṇā kutracid asti kalpe yathā prayuktaḥ sukhibhiḥ sa kalpaḥ // 39 // rasāyanavarasyāsya prayuktasya
analyzed: nānāvidha dravya viśeṣa yuktaḥ na yantraṇā kutracid asti kalpe yathā prayuktaḥ sukhibhiḥ sa kalpaḥ rasāyana varasya asya prayuktasya

original: 9 guṇāni mat* / samāsataḥ procyamānān suśrute 'gramanāḥ śṛṇu // 40 // kuṣṭhārocakagulmakāsakṛśatāśvitrāgnisādapraṇut* vātāsṛgdaraśūlaśoṣajaṭharaplihodarārśoharaḥ /
analyzed: guṇāni mat samāsatas procyamānān suśrute gramanāḥ śṛṇu kuṣṭha arocaka gulma kāsa kṛśa tā śvitra agni sāda praṇud vāta asṛgdara śūla śoṣa jaṭhara pliha udara arśaḥ haraḥ

analyzed: pakṣāghāta kaṭi graha krimi gada udāvarta meha apahaḥ tandrī pīnasa vāhu pṛṣṭa pavana apasmāra saṃsūdanaḥ śrīmān veṇu mṛdaṃga valgu ninadaḥ tapta agra hema dyutiḥ medhā dhī balavān

original: 3 jambvāmrāsthi tathā bilvaṃ yāśavatsakaśālmalān* / dhātaky ativiṣā lodhraṃ phalīn mecīkagairikāḥ // 415 // sataṇḍulaṃ guḍakṣaudraṃ mahāsāṃgrāhikaṃ pibet* / pibet trapusabījaṃ vā rasāṃjanasamāyutam* // 416 //

analyzed: arśasām jvariteṣu ca vāsavāya ūcatuḥ śreṣṭham yat uktam brahmaṇā purā candanam naladam rodhram uśīram padma kesaram nāgapuṣpam ca bilvam ca bhadramustā atha śarkarām hiriveram ca

original: 6 pāṭhāṃ ca kuṭajasya phalaṃ tvacam* // 420 // śṛṃgaveraṃ sātiviṣāṃ dhātakīṃ sarasāṃjanām* / āmrāsthi jambusārāsthi tathā mocarasaṃ bhavet* // 421 // nīlotpalaṃ samaṃgāṃ ca sūkṣmelāṃ dāḍimatvacam* /

original: 7 caturviṃśati caitāni samabhāgāni kārayet* // 422 // taṇḍulodakasaṃyuktaṃ kṣaudreṇa saha pāyayet* / hitaṃ lohitapittīnām arśasāṃ jvariteṣu ca // 423 // mūrchātamopasṛṣṭānāṃ
analyzed: caturviṃśati ca etāni sama bhāgāni kārayet taṇḍula udaka saṃyuktam kṣaudreṇa saha pāyayet hitam lohitapittīnām arśasām jvariteṣu ca

original: 8 tṛṣārttānāñ ca dāpayet* / atīsāraṃ ca chardiṃ ca strīṇāṃ ca rajanigraham* // 424 // aśvibhyām anumato yogo raktapittanivāraṇaḥ / pracyutānāñ ca garbhāṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ paraṃ ucyate // 425 // {X} raktapittinām

original: 9 āśvino yogaḥ ślo 12 {X} dadhisarpiś ca tailaṃ ca śṛṃgaveraṃ saphāṇitam* / kṣaudraṃ karkandhucūrṇaṃ ca sarvam āmathya pāyayet* // 426 // eṣa nirvāhikāyogaḥ prasahya vinivartayet* /

original: 10 latākuṃjopamaṃ ruddhaṃ nadīvegam ivānilaḥ // 427 // vadarīpatrakalkaṃ vāpy abhayārodhrayoś tathā / kapittharasasaṃyuktaṃ sakṣaudraṃ dadhinā pibet* // 428 // pravāhikāvedanayābhibhūtaḥ
analyzed: latā kuñja upamam ruddham nadī vegam iva anilaḥ 427 vadarī pattra kalkam vā api abhayā rodhrayoḥ tathā kapittha rasa saṃyuktam sa kṣaudram dadhinā pibet pravāhikā vedanayā abhibhūtaḥ

original: 11 _ _ pibed āḍhakimūlasiddham* / pūte ghṛte dhūpya punaḥ paceta sa vedanāṃ saṃśamayaty udīrṇām* // 429 // pravāhikāyāṃ trapusasya bījaṃ piṣṭaṃ pibet taṇḍuladhānyakena // 430a //
analyzed: pibet āḍhakī mūla siddham pūte ghṛte dhūpya punar paceta sa vedanām saṃśamayati udīrṇām pravāhikāyām trapusasya bījam piṣṭam pibet taṇḍuladhānyakena

original: r1 bṛṃhaṇaṃ madhuraṃ śītaṃ snigdhaṃ pānānnam iṣyate / pittopadiṣṭaśāṃtiṃ ca kurryāt kāse kṣatātmake // 431 // madhukaṃ pīppalī drākṣā lākṣā śṛṃgī śatāvarī / caturguṇā tugākṣīrī

original: 5 tulāṃ guḍasya tu pacet kuḍavaṃ ghṛtatailasya / kuḍavaṃ pippalīnāñ ca datvā lehe ca śītale // 438 // madhunaḥ kuḍavaṃ datvā sthāpayed ghṛtabhājane / lihyād yathābalaṃ lehaṃ
analyzed: tulām guḍasya tu pacet kuḍavam ghṛta tailasya kuḍavam pippalīnām ca da tvā lehe ca śītale madhunaḥ kuḍavam da tvā sthāpayet ghṛta bhājane lihyāt yathābalam leham

analyzed: barhi tittiri dakṣāṇām rasaiḥ sa vyoṣa dāḍimaiḥ sa hiṃgu viḍa mṛdvīkā mātuluṅga rasa ārdrakaiḥ kulattha dāḍima ajāji śuṣka mūlaka saṃyutaiḥ

analyzed: ṣaḍī puṣkara jīvantī mustā nāgara corakaiḥ pippalyā tāmalakyā ca surasā elā aguru tvacam sama aṃśa bālakam da tvā śarkarā aṣṭaguṇā bhavet

analyzed: lihyāt tu madhu sarpibhyām hikkā śvāsa nivṛttaye karjūram pippalī drākṣā śarkarā ca iti tat samam madhu sarpiḥ yutaḥ lehaḥ śvāsa hikkā nivāraṇaḥ

original: v1 x x x x ^ _ _ x śāligodhūmavaikṛtam* // 447 // jāṃgalānāṃ rasaiḥ śītair mṛdvīkāśarkarāyutaiḥ / śritaśītaiḥ payobhir vā saghṛtaiḥ sasitopalaiḥ // 448 // pibed drākṣārasaṃ śītaṃ śarkarāmalakodakam* / mṛdvīkāṃ
analyzed: śāli godhūma vaikṛtam 447 jāṅgalānām rasaiḥ śītaiḥ mṛdvīkā śarkarā yutaiḥ śrita śītaiḥ payobhiḥ vā sa ghṛtaiḥ sa sitopalaiḥ pibet drākṣā rasam śītam śarkarā āmalaka udakam mṛdvīkām

original: 5 pūtaṃ kaṣāyam avatārya / datvā kaṣāyatulyaṃ payo 'tha navasarpiṣaḥ prastham* // 455 // ṛṣabhakajīvakamedāṃ vidārivīkātmaguptānām* / bhavyākṣoḍanikocakaśṛṃgāṭakapadmabījānām* // 456 //

original: 7 ghṛtam idaṃ janakeśvarapūjitam* // 458 // kṣīṇe kṣate 'lpaśukre 'py atha sarucirapaittikeṣu rogeṣu / strīkāmeṣu ca deyaṃ vṛṣyaṃ balyaṃ ca ghṛtam etat* // 459 // drākṣā madhukakharjūravidārī saśatāvarī /

original: 10 ca // 464 // pāyayet sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ kausuṃbham athavā bhiṣak* / paṃcakolakasiddhaṃ vā pibet kāse kaphātmake // 465 // vyoṣapuṣkaramṛdvīkātriphalāṣaḍicitrakaiḥ / madhutailayuto lehaḥ kaphakāsanibarhaṇaḥ // 466 //

original: 11 tryūṣaṇaṃ triphalā dāru viḍaṃgā padmako balā / rāsnā ca sarve tulyāḥ syuḥ śarkarā madhusarpiṣī // 467 // lehayet tat kṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ kaphakāsanibarhaṇam* / tryūṣaṇatriphale _ x x x x x ^ _ ^ _ // 468 //
